_comment: Systematics-grade minimal_rho dijet DATA production on the 2026-08-06 pair_split fiducial (the processor default since 5f098fb). Same rho axis and running conditions as dijet_data_2018_minimal_rho.json; the only change is the selection. The systematic profile is left at minimal_syst because it is a no-op on data: the jetsyst loop skips every non-nominal entry when do_gen is False, and the data weights object carries no variations, so data is nominal-only by construction whatever the profile says. Also carries the per-jet kinematic validation hists, which is the point of the run -- they are the data leg of the pair_split kinematic data/MC ratios. JetHT Run2018A-D.
